protocol.semantic_projection: log_softmax([0, logit(p_anterior), logit(p_posterior)]); native-size prompt mask/query/presence confidence union
protocol.constraints: Mean of classwise one-vs-rest bands BCE and signed-face residual losses over background, anterior, posterior; includes A/P interface
protocol.inference: Image and two fixed text prompts only; argmax of three normalized class probabilities; no label-derived prompts or refinement

calibration.policy: median ratio target with p95 cap; edge relative to native+bands
